metadata.description: Claude Code mods built as function-hook plugins.

plugins.name: session-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt: context forecast and turns left, prompt cache countdown, rate limits with their pace, a cache hit warning, cost, and stand-up / late-night reminders. /meter shows the details.

plugins.name: handoff-relay
plugins.description: Holds the first /clear of a working conversation so Claude writes a handoff first; saves a mechanical one on exit; offers the newest handoff for this folder on your next prompt.
